page.layout: One printed page: title block at the top (two lines), a woodcut engraving in the centre, then the date below the woodcut. No columns, no margin notes.
page.notes: A woodcut engraving stands between the title lines and the date: a central oval cartouche with a seated female figure holding a ring-like wreath, flanked by two winged figures with palm branches, on a striped base. Not transcribed as text. The word "ANNO" is set in a decorative italic with an initial swash. The lower rule and date are printed in roman capitals.
